hint: WASD to walk  ·  E to look at something  ·  the steps down are south

spots.line: The stair. It goes up further than the building appears to.
Names cut into the wall, in columns. The columns are long.
A tally scratched beside the door. Two marks, then a gap, then one.
Whatever was on the floor here has been scrubbed at and not removed.
Packs laid in a row, tied shut, labelled. Nobody is coming for these.

chests.line: A footlocker at the wall, and the name on it worn to nothing.
Somebody's whole purse, left where the stair begins.

people.name: Sennet the Doorkeeper
chatter: You may go up. Nobody has ever needed permission.
I write the names down. It is not much, but it is what I can do.
Each floor is older than the one under it. Do not ask me how.
Some come down. I have stopped guessing which.

people.name: Bell the Cabin Hand
chatter: I carry the packs down. Never up. That's somebody else's job.
They pay me by the pack. I have never had a slow week.
You can leave a message with me. I keep them. All of them.

people.name: a wisp at the stairhead
chatter: It drifts down two steps, thinks better of it, and goes back up.
